name: hwp-workbench
description: Read, preview and save native HWP/HWPX text edits in a selected local document folder.
long_description: Developer alpha. Review hash-bound changes and compatibility warnings before saving a new native file. Document text is untrusted data. The server does not upload documents; your agent host may transmit tool results under its privacy settings. Full native editing and Hancom layout fidelity are not qualified. Requires Python 3.11 or newer on this Mac (for example from Homebrew); the bundled launcher finds it even when Claude Desktop starts with the system Python.

workspace_directory.title: Document folder
workspace_directory.description: Choose the smallest approved document folder. Avoid your whole home folder or filesystem.

tools.name: hwp_convert
tools.description: Report lossy HWP/HWPX/DOCX export through HWPX. DOC/ODT/RTF require LibreOffice. Writes a new file only with output plus acknowledgeRisks: true.

tools.name: hwp_session
tools.description: Read the desktop Agent link session and up to 200 bounded proposals and their outcomes. Does not write files.

tools.name: hwp_propose
tools.description: Validate a patch or edit preview and write a new Agent link proposal for desktop review. This does not edit the document.

tools.name: hwp_inspect
tools.description: Return text nodes, full node IDs and compatibility warnings. Use compact to omit the view and package parts.

tools.name: hwp_extract
tools.description: Return all document text without node references. Use read or search when you need IDs for editing.

tools.name: hwp_validate
tools.description: Check bounded container and parse integrity. This does not certify Hancom layout or interoperability.

tools.name: hwp_plan
tools.description: Validate a hash-bound patch and return before/after changes and warnings without writing.

tools.name: hwp_apply
tools.description: Apply a reviewed hash-bound patch to a new same-format file and verify reopening. Requires risk acknowledgement and refuses existing destinations.

tools.name: hwp_read
tools.description: Return paged text with short references mapped to full node IDs, table grid lines and warning codes. Call first to locate text and identify read-only nodes.

tools.name: hwp_search
tools.description: Return matching full node IDs, character offsets, context and editability. Regex accepts fixed-width syntax only; repetitions, groups and branches are refused.

tools.name: hwp_replace
tools.description: Return a hash-bound find/replace patch, diff and skipped targets; replacement text is literal. Supplying output and acknowledgeRisks saves a verified new file.

tools.name: hwp_fill
tools.description: Return a patch and resolved/unresolved HWPX form labels, choosing value cells to the right or below. Supplying output and acknowledgeRisks saves a new file; HWP cell mapping is unavailable.

tools.name: hwp_set
tools.description: Return a one-node text patch and diff using a full node ID or short reference. Supplying output and acknowledgeRisks saves a verified new file.
